name: GIB2A POWER - FrSky Neuron ESC Telemetry

releaseNotes.content:
# GIB2A POWER v26.1.1

Advanced FrSky Neuron ESC Telemetry Dashboard for ETHOS

Part of the GIB2A Advanced Telemetry Dashboard family.

- 24-sector Voltage, Battery, RPM, and temperature gauges
- Monotonic Battery percentage calculated from stabilized pack voltage
- Auto Bind for seven Neuron telemetry roles
- Configurable alarms, battery callouts, themes, and responsive layouts

Verify the installation and telemetry sources on the target radio before flight.
